''See also: [[Guild of Magisters Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[The Guild]] of [[Magisters]] is one of the [[Imperialist Guilds]] within the [[Aurelian Empire]]. While much of its membership consists of researchers and scholars, the organization is also known for employing assassins and has been accused of using them to target [[Regents]]. [[The Guild]]'s power is derived from the use of staves, which allow members to channel potent natural forces—such as those from plants or [[Elders]]—through their [[Intent]]. These staves are highly distinct, often decorated with crystals, and serve as a symbol of the danger [[Magisters]] pose to others. [[The Guild]]'s history is influenced by the philosophies of [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin Maze-walker]], also known as [[Curse-breaker]]. Although the [[Magisters]] are categorized alongside groups like the [[Blackwatch]] and the [[Imperial Guard]] as [[Imperialists]], their political allegiances have occasionally been viewed as enigmatic. The organization has also engaged in testing flying devices and creating specialized containers designed to be nearly invisible to the senses of a Reader. Following the death of its leader, [[Mekendi Maxeus]], the [[Guild]] has remained without an appointed Head, potentially waiting for the outcome of ongoing inter-guild conflicts.}}
